Frequently asked questions

Is there a word limit?

No. You can paste long texts, and results update instantly.

Will fancy text work on Instagram?

Yes. The Unicode styles work in most apps, including Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp.

Is my text saved?

No. Nothing you type is stored or sent anywhere.
